decision.reasoning_trace: I was looking for a durable, mid-range backpack for regular use or hiking. I evaluated the adidas Mesh Backpack (prod_backpacks_128), but it is too specialized for my needs. The larger hiking rucksacks like the Mardingtop 70L (prod_backpacks_137) and W WINTMING 45L (prod_backpacks_164) had concerning reviews regarding build quality, specifically issues with buckles breaking and 'cheap' manufacturing. The Granite Gear pack (prod_backpacks_041), which I also considered briefly, had reports of straps tearing on the first trip. The ZOMAKE (prod_backpacks_099) is a packable bag that lacks the structure I require for a primary bag. Because the technical bags in this set have questionable durability ratings from verified users, I have decided to wait and look for a more robust option.
